entities.name: PMID:25069714
observations: 2014 BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders study genotyped KIR genes in 312 RA patients; 179 were DAS28 good responders and 133 poor responders to methotrexate.
Full-length KIR2DS4 carriers had lower methotrexate response than KIR2DS4f-negative patients; effect was strongest at ESR 20–33 mm/h.

entities.name: KIR2DS4 full-length
observations: Full-length KIR2DS4 is the gene form associated with lower methotrexate response in one rheumatoid arthritis cohort.

entities.name: Methotrexate
observations: Treatment response in the KIR2DS4 study was categorized using DAS28 criteria.

entities.name: Rheumatoid arthritis
observations: The KIR2DS4–methotrexate response association was assessed in 312 patients with rheumatoid arthritis.

entities.name: KIR2DS4f MTX response
observations: In a 312-patient RA cohort, full-length KIR2DS4 carriers were less likely to respond to MTX than KIR2DS4f-negative patients; the association was strongest with intermediate ESR (20–33 mm/h). Abstract provides no effect size.
